name: 69120 · Arnold, NE
findings: ZIP 69120 (Arnold) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 69120 (Arnold) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 69120 (Arnold) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
